Euclid's division lemma and algorithm: a = bq + r with 0 ≤ r < b; the algorithm finds the HCF by repeated division.
Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic, HCF a: Prime factorisation is unique. HCF × LCM = product of the two numbers.
Irrational numbers: Irrational numbers are not p/q; roots like √2 are proved irrational by contradiction.
Decimal expansions of rational numbers: p/q terminates if q = 2ⁿ5ᵐ; otherwise it repeats.
